command: printf "BLOCK="; ls /sys/class/block; printf "DEV="; ls /dev/mmc*; printf "MODULES="; cat /proc/modules; printf "DTS_SPI="; ls /sys/bus/platform/devices; printf "MMC_LOG="; dmesg | sed -n /mmc/p; printf "SPI_LOG="; dmesg | sed -n /spi/p; printf "CONFIG="; test ! -f /proc/config.gz || zcat /proc/config.gz | sed -n "/CONFIG_MODULES=/p;/CONFIG_MMC/p;/CONFIG_SPI/p;/CONFIG_OF_OVERLAY/p"
